title: oodac
content:
## What it is

The openOODA compiler (`oodac`). Lexer, parser, Merkle AST, SSA mem2reg, optimization passes, and direct ELF64 / WASM / LLVM IR / C99 emission. Extracted from `ooda/oodac/` in 2026 (gemini v0.1.x reorg + cap-ABI alignment with the oodar v2.0.0 capability-token system).

The compiler verifies source code ahead-of-time. All side effects and privileged operations require explicit, unforgeable capability tokens. The compiler emits machine-readable diagnostics with automated one-turn repairs.

## Install

The compiler is shipped with the `ooda` toolchain. Install with `curl -fsSL https://openooda.org/install.sh | bash`; the `oodac` binary is on PATH afterwards.

## Surface

The compiler has 4 backends (per NORTHSTAR §5):

| Backend | What it emits |
|---------|---------------|
| ELF64 | Direct native binary (x86_64, AArch64). No libc on the hot path. |
| WASM | WebAssembly (WasmGC). Browser/edge sandboxed targets. |
| C99 | Portable C. Links against the oodar v2.0.0 runtime (`gcc oodar.c`). |
| LLVM IR | LLVM optimizer chain + SIMD vectorization for hot loops. |

Backend selection is via `ooda build --target=<elf|wasm|c99|llvm>` (see `cli/` v0.2.1+).

The compiler is the substrate; the standard library, package manager, CLI driver, language server, MCP server, and runtime are siblings, not dependencies. v0.1.x ships the cap-ABI alignment with the oodar v2.0.0 cap system (every public mutation takes a capability token, oo_alloc/free/write_int/read_int/checkpoint/rollback + the 12 oo_weak_*/oo_control_block_* mutators).
